notes:
Snapshot: Mid-market ITSM vendor building internal helpdesk/chatbot (LucidOps Agent). Looking to start on Hosted API for speed-to-value, then move to Dedicated if latency/cost predictability requires it. POC summary: 2-week Hosted API POC focusing on chat/agent workload with streaming + function-calling. Simulated environment: ~350 concurrent internal agents, average turn length 12 tokens, burst to 600 concurrent during shift changes. Key asks: 95th pct streaming latency <= 300ms (token-level) and end-to-end turn completions < 800ms for short replies. They measured median ~120ms token latency on Redwood hosted during POC but saw 95th spikes ~420ms during a synthetic burst — will request guidance on batching/auto-scaling and route fallbacks.

Security & compliance: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs for all message history, retention controls (30/90/365 day options), KMS integration for at-rest keys, SOC2 attestation required before procurement. Quote from CTO: "Fast answers are table stakes — we need predictable SLOs more than lowest $/token." Finance/Procurement: sensitive to per-token spend; estimated ARR target $50-150k; prefer committed Dedicated pool if unit economics improve by 20-30%.

Operational notes: interested in streaming to provide agent UI typing and in-tool calling to update tickets (PUT /tickets/{id}). Need structured tool-calling examples for Zendesk/Jira integrations. Also asked about model catalog and automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants during capacity constraints. SE suggested Redwood Optimize recommendations (quant profiles) and canary rollout for Dedicated. Security review open items: retention policy artifact, legal DPA language for internal message logs, and KMS key rotation policy.

Next steps (internal): AE to deliver Dedicated pricing tiers + 12-month commit options; SE to produce a runbook for achieving 95th pct latency target at their projected concurrency; schedule CTO+Head of Ops call to sign off on security/legal. POC artifacts: drive folder (POC logs + latency dashboards), Fireflies transcripts attached.
